mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.name as teacher_name, cl.class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id = cl.id ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT c.*, u.name as teacher_name, cl.class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id = cl.id WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT c.*, u.name as teacher_name, cl.class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id = cl.id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
SELECT c.*, u.name as teacher_name, cl.class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id = cl.id WHERE c.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.*, u.name as teacher_name, cl.class_name FROM course c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.id LEFT JOIN class cl ON c.class_id = cl.id INNER JOIN user s ON c.class_id = s.class_id WHERE s.id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course (course_name, course_code, teacher_id, class_id, semester, description) VALUES (#{courseName}, #{courseCode}, #{teacherId}, #{classId}, #{semester}, #{description})
